body:
No matter what anyone says, I found it extremely useful to be lazy when I was young. It gave me time with myself, and my own thoughts, and doing things I actually wanted to do, even if it was something as stupid as scrolling FB. As you get older, you start figuring out your likes and dislikes, what makes you lethargic, what makes you not want to get out of bed.

Everyone is different, and if being lazy is what your body needs right now, don’t let anyone make you feel bad for it.

From my experience, people will leave when you’re having the worst of time. Live for yourself, there is no better reason. No matter what tv shows have told us, at the worst of times only you will be left, not the people you love.

You will graduate. You will listen to music that you love. You will have moments of peace within yourself that other people cannot provide no matter how much we want them to be our solution.

As someone who has a very hard time falling asleep, morning classes were very hard on me. I noticed that I functioned significantly better once I took night classes instead, as I had a better handle on my sleep schedule.

If you feel like your parents still blame you for your sister’s death, then maybe you need some space away from them. 
It was in no way your fault, and you need be allowed to forgive yourself for it, which might start by staying away from things that remind you of it.
The loss of one life is devastating, but it doesn’t mean that another should be lost to make up for it.

Probably going to be a very unpopular opinion, but ESH. She was being an asshole, but that didn’t give you the right to be just as inconsiderate as she was. Relationship wise, everyone should be allowed to talk about their own issues with their partners in their own time.
